description: Red is the album where I realized a breakup isn't one color — it's burning red, it's blue, it's a whole spectrum. I was writing this when I was 22 and figuring out that love is rarely simple. It's patchwork and a little all over the place, and honestly? That's exactly what being 22 felt like. I'm so proud of how it sprawls, even if it's not perfectly tidy 🫶💕
